note: Pre-written guided-probe scripts (deterministic fallback for the probe feature). Each item is asked by the teacher; teacher records pass/fail.

probes.title_hi: उधार समझ रहा है या नहीं?

items.ask_hi: सवाल: 40 में से 16 निकालने के लिए उधार लिया? कहाँ से?

probes.tell_hi: 2/2 सही → गलती लापरवाही की; 1/2 → उधार में फिर से अभ्यास; 0/2 → आधार कमज़ोर।

probes.title_hi: मात्रा नहीं पता या शब्द नहीं पता?

items.ask_hi: गृहभाषा में एक शब्द बोलो जिसमें आ की आवाज़ है

probes.tell_hi: हिंदी में 1/4 पर गृहभाषा में सही → भाषा का मामला; दोनों में कम → मात्रा का आधार कमज़ोर।

probes.title_hi: कौन से अक्षर मिल रहे हैं?
probes.tell_hi: स/श में गलती → कार्ड से जोड़े बनाएँ।

probes.title_hi: कौन सी मात्राएँ मिल रही हैं?
probes.tell_hi: जो जोड़ी में कम → उसी जोड़ी का अभ्यास।
अंक को जोड़ने की गलती → तिलियों के बंडल।

items.ask_hi: Show the letter b. Ask: What letter is this?
Show the letter d. Ask: What letter is this?
Show the letter p. Ask: What letter is this?
Show the letter q. Ask: What letter is this?

probes.tell_hi: b and d swapped, or p and q: practise that pair with the bat-and-ball clue. Most letters wrong: go back to letters A to M, a few each day.

items.ask_hi: What is the first sound in 'sun'?
What is the first sound in 'pen'?

probes.tell_hi: The child says the letter name ('ess', 'pee'): teach the short sound with a thing from the room (s - sun). Right sound for some letters only: practise those letters.
Guesses from the first letter (cat as car): blend slowly sound by sound with stones. Changes the middle sound (pen as pin): practise a, e, i, o, u in the middle.

probes.title_hi: Can the child read a short sentence?

items.ask_hi: Read this sentence: I see a cat.
Read this sentence: The sun is hot.
Read this sentence: I have a red pen.

probes.pass_rule: 2 of 3 read without skipping a word
probes.tell_hi: Skips small words (is, the, a): practise those words on slips. Stops at every word: read the line together, then again alone, a little faster.

probes.title_hi: Can the child make a sentence?

items.ask_hi: Make a sentence with: red, ball
Make a sentence with: cow, milk
Make a sentence with: rain, road, wet

probes.pass_rule: 2 of 3 are full sentences using all the words
probes.tell_hi: Only says the words in a row: add a doing word together (The cow gives milk). Puts words in Hindi order (I mango eat): practise with word slips, who - does what - what.
